topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I can't even breathe right, I just found this old notebook of theirs, tucked away in the back of the closet. It's a bucket list, and I'm staring at these things they want to do, and I can't help but wonder if any of them include me. Like, sure, we talk about our dreams sometimes, but this is different. It’s like opening a window to their soul, and it’s shaking me to the core. I guess I always thought our future plans were enough. Now, I'm just staring at these pages, trying to figure out where I fit into all of this.
